title: SortCriteria
description: Specifies criteria for sorting the results of a request for findings.

allOf.description: The name of the property to sort the results by. This value can be the name of any property that Amazon Macie defines for a finding.

The sort order to apply to the results, based on the value for the property specified by the attributeName property. Valid values are: ASC, sort the results in ascending order; and, DESC, sort the results in descending order.
